notes.title: Major Update – Complete Overhaul with Unreal Engine 5
notes.content:
Content of the Update:


Upgrade to Unreal Engine 5: A major technological leap that improves graphics, lighting, and game performance. Enjoy a smoother and more immersive experience.
Complete User Interface Overhaul: A clearer and more intuitive design for easier navigation.


New Features:


New Melee Weapon: The baseball bat! Can be used for close combat attacks, with endurance management and the option to block.
Push Action: Push zombies or other characters with any equipped weapon.
New Animation for the ZAR-1: More fluidity and realism in the weapon's movements.
New Zombie Movement Animation: More natural and impactful movements for a better experience.
Bandage Application Animation Added: Apply your bandages with a new immersive animation.


Improvements:


Locker Overhaul: Improved organization and management of stored items.
Shop Overhaul: You can now purchase weapons. Price adjustments and changes to the sale of resources (now selling for 50 units instead of 100).
Loot System Modified: Improved distribution of lootable items, with adjustments to the frequency and variety of found items.


New Content:

Added NPC Gabriel Nozak: A new key character who will give you interesting quests to enrich your adventure.
First Quest Given by Gabriel Nozak: Embark on the quest offered by this character to begin an exciting series of missions.

notes.title: Update 0.0.1.5
notes.content:
General

Additions:


Storage locker to organize your items.
2K resolution support on certain objects for improved visual quality.
New handgun: P9.
Key point markers added to the colony for easier exploration.
Escape button functionality to close HUD windows (loot, shop, inventory).
The loot button now disappears after picking up an item.
Click sound added to HUD menus for the shop and storage locker.


Improvements:


 New 3D model for the ZAR-1 weapon.
 Adjusted footstep volume based on movement speed.


Fixes:


 The EULA (End-User License Agreement) no longer remains displayed after being accepted.


Player

Additions:


 Stamina system for more realistic physical effort management.
 Added missing footstep sounds for certain animations.


Improvements:


 Footstep sound range reduced by 50% for increased stealth.


Zombies

Balance Adjustments:


 Reduced zombie attack range.
 Lowered zombie damage from 20 to 15.


Improvements:


 Partial rework of the attack system for better realism.
